commitResults.messageTitle: Completed rename, greet, exit; updated .gitignore for .class files
Added user input echo and exit
Added user task list: task add and list print
Added ability to mark/unmark tasks as complete via Task class
Add minimum implementations of task types
Add support for tracking todo, deadline, event tasks
Add TaskList class to handle task operations
Add minimal error handling; input parsing separated into own method
Add support for deleting tasks from TaskList
Create temp enum for commands, yet to integrate with rest of program
Add initial save file creation and file read
commitResults.messageBody:
Curret version of file read is untested

File read implementation requires new file corruption exception,
this is bundled together with the commit

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for saving and updating tasks in file
commitResults.messageBody:
Update existing tasks happens for mark, unmark, delete;
this involves rewriting the entire file in O(N) time

This resolves complexities with random access read/write,
hinging on users not ballooning save file size

Task, TaskList, and relevant task subclasses updated with
method to convert to an easily parsable string for saving

.gitignore updated accordingly to ignore save file that
contains test contents
Contains functionality for saving task list to hard disk

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for LocalDate; save read bug found
